answers.drew: I was a very artsy kid and always knew I wanted a career that could become my primary creative outlet. I did theater for most of my life, but as I began exploring other paths, I became increasingly drawn to film. It offered a broader range of creative opportunities and more room for growth than I felt I had in theater. Once I made that decision before college, I began actively pursuing opportunities in the entertainment industry.
